summary: First full test iteration for ExportPilot AI MVP. Executed pytest backend suite (27 tests) covering dashboard, inquiry analyze (LLM), deals CRUD + stage + doctor, pricing calc + incoterm variations + simulate, quotations (create/list/get), negotiation (analyze/respond/approve), export pack (7 docs, HTML preview, download attachment header), compose-email + send-to-buyer (delivered=false expected), follow-ups (list/generate/complete), buyers (list/detail), and AI Export Manager assistant (with prepare_export_pack action detection). All 27 backend tests passed. Ran end-to-end Playwright UI flow against the external URL: Landing -> /app, Inbox load-sample -> Analyze -> Create Deal -> Quotation tab (calculate, slider, generate quotation preview) -> Export Pack tab (generate 7 docs, Send-to-Buyer dialog, send success) -> Deals Kanban (6 columns) -> Negotiation (analyze -> strategy -> generated response -> approve) -> Follow-ups (generate + send) -> Buyers table + detail -> AI Manager FAB with prepare_export_pack action button -> Coming Soon page. All UI flows passed.

minor.issue: Occasionally takes >60s (LLM latency). Test timeout raised to 90s to be safe.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> injected inside <option> (caused by instrumentation-added elements). Non-fatal, but produces console warnings on every page with a <select> of dynamic options. Consider suppressing instrumentation on <option> text or using a headless Radix Select.

action_items: Optional: reduce LLM latency spikes on /api/negotiation/analyze or add streaming indicator so users see progress (button already shows disabled/analyzing state - fine).
Optional: Investigate hydration warning on <option> caused by instrumentation-injected <span> to keep console clean.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 1114-line file. Consider splitting into routers (deals, quotations, negotiation, docs, followups, dashboard, assistant) once feature set stabilizes.

assistant_ask intent detection uses 'or' with mixed precedence: `'export pack' in q or 'prepare' in q and 'pack' in q` — currently evaluates correctly due to Python precedence, but wrap in parentheses for clarity.
compute_pricing caps margin at 95% (good), but doesn't handle negative desired_margin explicitly beyond max(0,...) — acceptable.
send_to_buyer performs a synchronous `requests.post` inside async endpoint when RESEND_API_KEY is set; use httpx.AsyncClient to avoid blocking the event loop. Not exercised in this env (no key).
All MongoDB reads correctly exclude _id via projection. Good.
No input validation on stage transitions in PATCH /api/deals/{id}/stage — any string accepted. Consider Literal[...] enum.
test_credentials: N/A - app has no login (jumps to /app demo workspace).
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 5 buyers + 8 deals + quotations + follow-ups on startup. Test suite adds a persistent TEST_ prefixed buyer/deal for regression flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and are pytest-xdist safe. External URL from frontend/.env is used. The compose-email and negotiation LLM calls can take 20-60s each; keep timeouts >= 60s. Assistant 'prepare export pack for Dubai Harvest Trading' correctly returns an action object with prepare_export_pack + deal_id. Send-to-buyer returns delivered=false intentionally when RESEND_API_KEY is absent — that is EXPECTED behaviour and must not be treated as a bug.
